```yaml
name: Check AI Co-authors

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  check-ai-co-authors:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Check for AI co-authors
        id: check
        run: |
          # Define the blocklist patterns
          EMAIL_PATTERNS=(
            "noreply@anthropic.com"
            "noreply@sourcegraph.com"
            "noreply@openai.com"
            "codex@openai.com"
            "aider@aider.chat"
            "gemini@google.com"
            "jules@google.com"
            "@codeium.com"
            "devin@cognition.ai"
            "cline@cline.ai"
            "continue@continue.dev"
          )

          NAME_PATTERNS=(
            "Claude"
            "Copilot"
            "Cursor"
            "Codex"
            "Gemini"
            "Aider"
            "Devin"
            "Windsurf"
            "Cline"
            "Amazon Q"
            "Jules"
            "OpenCode"
            "devin-ai-integration"
            "amazon-q-developer"
            "cline-bot"
            "continue-agent"
          )

          # Get the PR commits
          PR_COMMITS=$(git log --format="%H" ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}..${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }})

          if [ -z "$PR_COMMITS" ]; then
            echo "No commits to check."
            exit 0
          fi

          FOUND_ISSUES=0
          OUTPUT_MSG=""

          for COMMIT_HASH in $PR_COMMITS; do
            # Get commit message
            COMMIT_MSG=$(git log -1 --format="%B" $COMMIT_HASH)
            
            # Check for Co-authored-by trailers
            if echo "$COMMIT_MSG" | grep -q "Co-authored-by:"; then
              # Extract all Co-authored-by lines
              CO_AUTHORS=$(echo "$COMMIT_MSG" | grep "Co-authored-by:")
              
              while IFS= read -r line; do
                # Extract name and email
                AUTHOR_NAME=$(echo "$line" | sed 's/Co-authored-by: \(.*\) <.*>/\1/')
                AUTHOR_EMAIL=$(echo "$line" | sed 's/.*<\(.*\)>/\1/')
                
                # Check against email patterns
                for pattern in "${EMAIL_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
                  if echo "$AUTHOR_EMAIL" | grep -qi "$pattern"; then
                    FOUND_ISSUES=1
                    OUTPUT_MSG+="❌ Commit $COMMIT_HASH contains AI co-author: $line\n"
                    break
                  fi
                done
                
                # Check against name patterns
                for pattern in "${NAME_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
                  if echo "$AUTHOR_NAME" | grep -qi "$pattern"; then
                    FOUND_ISSUES=1
                    OUTPUT_MSG+="❌ Commit $COMMIT_HASH contains AI co-author: $line\n"
                    break
                  fi
                done
                
              done <<< "$CO_AUTHORS"
            fi
          done

          if [ $FOUND_ISSUES -eq 1 ]; then
            echo "::error::AI co-authors detected in pull request commits."
            echo "$OUTPUT_MSG"
            echo "Please remove AI co-author trailers from your commits."
            echo "You can do this by rebasing and amending your commits:"
            echo "  git rebase -i HEAD~N"
            echo "Then change 'pick' to 'edit' for the relevant commits and run:"
            echo "  git commit --amend --no-edit"
            echo "Finally, force push your changes:"
            echo "  git push --force-with-lease"
            exit 1
          else
            echo "✅ No AI co-authors detected."
          fi
```
